text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Vietnamese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Russia's visiting lower house speaker, Gennady Seleznyov, has called for strengthened ties with Vietnam.
-- China's Communist Party Secretary General, Jiang Zemin and Vietnamese politburo member Nguyen Tan Dung met on Friday in Beijing and discussed bilateral ties.
-- The Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee has outlined a masterplan for the city socio economic development for the period 1996 to 2010.
-- The Institute of Atomic Energy and the Ministry of Industry are conducting a feasibility for the country's first nuclear power plant.
-- Politburo standing board member Le Kha Phieu has called on communist party cells, local authorities and social organizations to contribute to the development of the national health care system.
-- Vietnam is seeking to promote and expand overseas markets for locally produced consumer goods.
-- Defence Miniter General Doan Khue has called for heightened vigilance by soldiers working for air defence units.
-- The Labour, War Invalids and Social Affairs Ministry will reinforce nationwide inspection of implementation of the Labour Code.
-- The Vietnam National Coffee Export-Import Corporation expects coffee output of 260,000 tonnes in the 96/97 coffee crop.
